description: A computable finite approximation to \(A\subseteq\mathbb N\) supplies total computable functions \(c(s)\) and \(d(s,x)\), with \(d\) zero-one valued, such that \(d(s,x)=1\) implies \(x<c(s)\), positive tests persist to the next stage, and \(x\in A\) exactly when some stage tests positive.
